A '''hadron''' is a composite particle made up of [[quark]]s and/or [[antiquark]]s.

Hadrons fall into two main categories:

* '''[[Baryon]]s''' and '''[[Antibaryon]]s''', made up of three quarks/antiquarks.
* '''[[Meson]]s and [[antimeson]]s''', made up of a quark and an antiquark.

== Properties ==

=== $Q=Ne$ (Integer charge) ===

While quarks and antiquarks have fractional charges of $\pm\frac{2}{3}e$ or $\pm\frac{1}{3}e$, the charges of hadrons must be integer multiples of $e$.<ref>{{#cite:Q2498}}</ref>
